description: Find countries by wealth-protection tax criteria — no personal income tax, no inheritance tax, no wealth tax, no capital gains tax, territorial taxation, non-CRS (no automatic financial-account exchange), not on the EU tax black/grey list, or crypto-friendly (favourable crypto-asset tax regime). Returns matching countries with their HNWI tax + CRS + EU-list (+ crypto) snapshot. Combine with a residence or citizenship route for a full tax-plus-pathway view.

crypto_friendly.description: True to require a favourable published treatment of digital assets.

no_capital_gains_tax.description: True to require no capital-gains tax.

no_income_tax.description: True to require no personal income tax.

no_inheritance_tax.description: True to require no inheritance or estate tax.

no_wealth_tax.description: True to require no net-wealth tax.

non_crs.description: True to restrict to jurisdictions outside the CRS automatic-exchange network. Note: Mirabello advises full tax compliance; this is a factual filter, not a concealment tool.

not_eu_listed.description: True to exclude jurisdictions on the EU list of non-cooperative tax jurisdictions.

territorial.description: True to require a territorial tax system (foreign income untaxed).

name: find_low_tax

outputSchema.description: Mirabello response envelope. Tool-specific fields vary; the provenance/disclaimer envelope is always present.

book_url.description: Link to request a consultation with a Mirabello specialist, for a personal case.

data_updated.description: Date the underlying dataset was last updated.

disclaimer.description: Information, not legal/tax/financial/immigration advice; figures indicative.

error.description: Present only when the request could not be fulfilled.

source.description: Attribution for the data, when it is not Mirabello Consultancy itself.
